text:
Maya: FYI NuvoPay reported p95 jump from ~220ms -> ~1.8s since last deploy at 11:02 UTC. Customer seeing timeouts on checkout flows. Support ticket SUP-4921.
OncallBot: deploy finished: service=runtime-api image=redwood/runtime:v2.14.0 env=prod zone=us-west-2 ts=2026-03-15T11:02:04Z
Olivia: ack. Can someone pull p95 per-region and per-model for the last 30m? suspect batching/config change.
Raj: grabbing metrics now. checking scaling events, queue length, and GPU util.
Tim: note we rolled a quantization/kernel tweak in v2.14.0 that changed execution path for some sequence lengths — could be longer token latency.
Sara: customer says spikes align with large checkouts (seq len ~800). they get timeouts after 1.5s.
Raj: quick metric snapshot: p95_tokens us-west-2=1800ms @11:09; gpu_util=92%; cpu_queue=0.8; autoscaler scaled down a node at 11:08.
Olivia: scale-down during sudden load = autoscaler cooldown too aggressive or scale-in threshold misfired. also want to see cache hit rate.
Tim: checked rollout config: prefix_kv_cache=false for canary in this deploy. If KV caching is off for long sequences, that explains higher per-token cost and latency.
Maya: customer wants ETA. If hotfix to re-enable cache is straightforward, we'll prioritize. Can we also temporarily route them to a dedicated pool?
Raj: routing nuvo-org to dedicated pool (nuvo-org-pool) is possible; need ~15m for infra change and to warm instances. I'll start the change.
Olivia: action list: Tim -> hotfix to re-enable prefix_kv_cache and promote; Raj -> route nuvo-org to dedicated pool; Maya/Sara -> update customer + ETA. Any objections?
Tim: starting PR now (branch: fix/prefix-cache-regen). Running local perf tests, ETA ~30m for validation + canary.
OncallBot: incident created INC-2026-198 priority=high owner=oncall
Maya: thanks. I'll post an interim update to SUP-4921 and give 1h ETA.
Olivia: keep thread updated with PR link and routing confirmation. If hotfix fails, fallback plan is to roll back v2.14.0 to v2.13.8.
